priorFindings.evidence: Jev adapter deterministically escalates blocked/unknown; both stores reject injected nonterminal decisions; new tests cover the path.
SQL episode join requires equal targetCheckId and policy digests; memory filters those fields; new tests cover a multi-target strategy.
Versioned snapshot now carries authoritative mission/slice/reserved budget, reported usage, and digest-only evidence refs; SQL compares persisted snapshot plus current budget context before commit.

findings.title: Unresolved pass can become lesson candidate success evidence
findings.reason: An invalid or uncertain judgment after a worker-reported pass persists progress with decision_status=unknown in SQL or with no committed receipt in memory. The later candidate scan checks only progress.status=passed, so a subsequent committed pass from another slice can pair the unresolved pass with an earlier failure and create a candidate claiming two completed recoveries. The C1a candidate record must retain accurate event provenance even while promotion is closed.
findings.repair: Select only committed SQL failure/pass actions and only memory progress events with committed receipts. Add a two-episode regression where one pass judgment becomes UNKNOWN and no candidate is emitted.

findings.title: Comparable scope cohort is not consistently enforced across stores
findings.reason: Memory candidate scanning groups prior passes by repository, target, strategy, and policy but never checks the prior slice's derived scope cohort; a docs episode can count toward a src candidate under a wildcard-approved strategy. SQL derives the current cohort from sorted scopes, but its prior-episode filter uses scopes[0]; valid unsorted multi-scope plans can therefore disagree with memory and lose comparable episodes.
findings.repair: Use one deterministic cohort derivation for current and historical episodes in both stores, and add cross-cohort plus unsorted multi-scope parity tests.
